entries.4430a575375b4ea9: Since its founding, the company's philosophy has been to offer products that completely exclude the “Four Major Additives (chemical seasonings, artificial sweeteners, synthetic colorings and artificial preservatives)” from all ingredients, and it aims to be a company that contributes to the happiness of people around the world through sushi, a representative of Japanese food culture.
entries.45c0e76ae547e11f: Since its founding, the company's philosophy has been to offer products that completely exclude the “Four Major Additives (chemical seasonings, artificial sweeteners, synthetic colorings and artificial preservatives)” from all ingredients, and it aims to be a company that contributes to the happiness of people around the world through sushi, a representative of Japanese food culture. In its long-term vision announced in January 2020, it sets fiscal 2030 as the final year, positions this as a second founding phase, and sets targets of worldwide revenue of ¥360 billion or more and 1,100 or more stores, by expanding in Japan and overseas in tandem. It states that it will open only company-operated stores and accelerate overseas expansion based on the know-how it has accumulated.
entries.504a5cf8893e14f3: It operates all of its conveyor-belt sushi restaurants, 'Kura Sushi', which focus on sushi, as directly operated stores. The number of stores is 548 in Japan, 79 in the US and 60 in Asia, for a total of 687 stores (as of October 31, 2025). It has adopted original systems such as the antibacterial sushi cover 'Sendo-kun' and 'Bikkura Pon!', which allows customers to play a game with their empty plates.
